stem:
Bhavna sorts classroom cards into renewable and non-renewable resources.

Which classification is correct?

options.text: Petroleum is renewable because it can form again someday from buried remains.
Forests are non-renewable because a cleared patch looks empty right away.

Air, water and forests are renewable when nature can replenish them in a reasonable time; coal, petroleum and natural gas are non-renewable because they take millions of years and get exhausted with use.
Petroleum is renewable and forests are non-renewable for the reasons in A and B.

teacher.key_rationale: Renewable means replenished in a reasonable time; fossil fuels fail that test. A drops the time condition; B judges by immediate appearance; D combines both errors.
